          About this item

          • Seamless Apple Find My Integration (iOS Only): No monthly fees and download an extra app. Simply open the Apple "Find My" app, add your smart tracker to the "Items" tab, and you’re ready to go. Enjoy a straightforward, quick, and highly convenient setup exclusively designed for Apple users.
          • Find Far Away: When you left something behind,Even when your item is outside of Bluetooth range, this item tracker utilizes the secure, global network of hundreds of millions of Apple devices,just check the Find My app to pinpoint location on the map and prevent loss.
          • Find Nearby With Loud Alarm: Misplaced your essentials at home,just open the Find My app or ask Siri for help,and tap “Play Sound.” The tracker will emit a loud,clear chime (80-100dB),allowing you to follow the sound and find your belongings in no time.
          • Sharing &Protect Privacy: Easily share your item's location with trusted family members and friends (supported on iOS 17 and later). Built with strict privacy standards, this MFi-certified Bluetooth tracker ensures that all your location data and history remain fully encrypted, anonymous, and protected.
          • Long Battery Life & Replaceable Battery: The bluetooth tracking tag CR2032 battery can last up to a year and comes with a replacement battery and you can view the battery indicator within the Find My app.
          • Lost Mode and Easy Attachment: Activate Lost Mode to safely display your contact info, making it easy for anyone to return your item. Comes with a protective case and keychain for quick attachment to keys, wallet, backpack, or luggage.

          Product description

          Seamless Apple Integration & Siri Control

          Effortlessly keep track of your valuables with our Smart Tag Tracker.

          Designed exclusively for the Apple ecosystem, it works seamlessly with the native Apple Find My app—no extra downloads or third-party accounts required.

          Compact Design, Powerful Performance

          Measuring just 1.2 inches (3.1 cm) wide and 0.35 inches (0.9 cm) thin, this pocket-sized item finder fits anywhere. It features an IP67 waterproof rating to withstand rain or splashes, and boasts a full 365-day standby time. Experience precision global tracking without the bulk.

          Precision Tracking, Near or FarWhether your item is hiding under the couch or left in another city, we have you covered.

          Whether your item is hiding under the couch or left in another city, we have you covered.

          If it's nearby, use the app to play a loud sound and locate it instantly. If it's out of Bluetooth range, leverage the global Apple Find My network to view its latest location on the map and get precise walking or driving directions.

          Left-Behind Alerts

          Stop losing things before they are truly lost.

          If you accidentally walk away from your wallet, keys, or bag, your iPhone will instantly send you a push notification, ensuring you never leave your essentials behind at a cafe or office again.

          Secure Family Sharing

          Keep your family connected and your shared items secure.

          With iOS 17 or later, you can securely share this tracking tag with multiple family members. Everyone in the group can monitor the item's location, and track its movements in real-time right from their own Apple devices.

          Secure "Lost Mode" for Easy Recovery

          If your item is completely lost, simply enable "Lost Mode" in the Find My app and enter your contact details.

          As soon as another device within the Apple network detects your tracking tag, you will receive an automatic notification. You can also securely include your phone number or email address, allowing anyone who finds your item to easily contact you and help you retrieve your valuables.

          Versatile Protection for Everything You Love

          Designed for ultimate versatility, this tracker tag can be attached to virtually anything.

          Q1: Does this smart tag require a monthly subscription fee or a third-party app?

          A: No, there are absolutely no monthly fees or subscriptions required! This smart tag connects directly to the native Apple "Find My" app already installed on your iOS device. You do not need to download any third-party tracking software.

          Q2: Will this tracker work with Android phones like Samsung or Google Pixel?

          A: No, this specific tag is designed exclusively for the Apple ecosystem. It only supports Apple devices running iOS 14.5 and later. It is not compatible with Android devices.

          Q3: What is the tracking range? Can I track my luggage if I fly to another country?

          A: Yes, you can track it globally! When the tag is nearby (within Bluetooth range), you can play a sound to find it. When it is far away—even in another country—it uses the millions of Apple devices in the "Find My" network to update its location on your map securely and anonymously.

          Q4: Is this tracking device waterproof enough for a dog collar?

          A: Yes! This tracker is IP67 certified waterproof and dustproof. It can easily handle rain, splashes, and everyday adventures, making it a great and durable choice to attach to your pet's collar.

          Q5: How long does the battery last, and is it replaceable?

          A: The tracker comes with a long-lasting battery that provides up to 365 days of standby time. When the battery eventually runs low, the battery (standard CR2032 coin cell) can be easily replaced by the user.

          Q6: Can my wife and I both track the same set of car keys on our own phones?

          A: Yes, you can! As long as both users have their Apple devices updated to iOS 17, iPadOS 17, or macOS 14 (or later), you can securely share the tag's location with family members or friends so multiple people can track the same item.

          2. Why We Started CREASO

            CREASO started with a simple idea: everyday life should feel a little less stressful. In a busy household, there are always things to remember—where the keys were left, which bag was taken, or where the luggage was last seen. We created CREASO trackers to make those little moments easier to handle. Simple to use and made for everyday life, our trackers help you keep an eye on the belongings you rely on, wherever the day takes you.

          Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.
